name: findingsteel-steel-sections-mcp
description: MCP server for Chinese (GB) standard steel sections: look up section properties (A, Ix, Iy, Wx, Wy, ix, iy) and calculate theoretical weight for H-beams, I-beams, channels, angles, C/Z purlins, square/rectangular hollow sections and welded sections.
author: FindingSteel (Jiangxin Steel Structure)

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/e2e_stdio.mjs && node test/e2e_http.mjs
